newsitem.title: USA: Panenergy says 100 mmcfd USG gas back today.
newsitem.headline: Panenergy says 100 mmcfd USG gas back today.

text.p: Panenergy Corp said Wednesday about 100 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas still cut by producers on its Texas Eastern system in Louisiana will likely be fully restored later today.
"On our Venice system, there's still about 100 million still not back on. That should all be back sometime today," said company spokesman John Barnett.
About 350 mmcfd had been cut on the TETCO pipeline system this week by producers as they evacuated platforms in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico ahead of Tropical Storm Josephine.
Panenergy also said that all 350 mmcfd of gas production shut in on its Trunkline's system had been restored following the storm.
